asyncapi.description: The AsyncAPI specification version of this document

info.description: Provides metadata about the API. The metadata can be used by the clients if needed

baseTopic.description: The base topic to the API. Example: 'hitch'

servers.description: An array of Server Objects, which provide connectivity information to a target server

topics.description: Relative paths to the individual topics. They must be relative to the 'baseTopic'

components.description: An object to hold a set of reusable objects for different aspects of the AsyncAPI Specification

tags.description: A list of tags used by the specification with additional metadata. Each tag name in the list MUST be unique

security.description: A declaration of which security mechanisms can be used with this API. The list of values includes alternative security requirement objects that can be used

externalDocs.description: Allows referencing an external resource for extended documentation
